title: Balochistan Local Government Election Second Amendment Ordinance 2002

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Local Government Election Second Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XX OF 2002
BALOCHISTAN LOCAL
GOVERNMENT ELECTION
(SECOND AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XX OF 2002
(An Ordinance further to amend the Balochistan Local
Government Election Ordinance, 2000)
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 26th November, 2002]
No. Legis 1-122/Law/2000-VIII,
dated 26-11-2002.---The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan 22nd November, 2002, is hereby published for general information:
--
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Balochistan Local
Government Election (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 18A of Ordinance VI of 2000

ORDINANCE XX OF 2002
BALOCHISTAN LOCAL
GOVERNMENT ELECTION
(SECOND AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XX OF 2002
(An Ordinance further to amend the Balochistan Local
Government Election Ordinance, 2000)
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 26th November, 2002]
No. Legis 1-122/Law/2000-VIII,
dated 26-11-2002.---The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan 22nd November, 2002, is hereby published for general information:
--
2. Amendment of section 18A of
Ordinance VI of 2000.---In the Balochistan Local Government Election
Ordinance, 2000, in section 18A.-
(i) in subsection (4), for the
word "sixty days", the words "one hundred and twenty days"
shall be substituted; and
(ii) in subsection (5) for the words "thirty
days", the words "one, hundred and twenty days" shall be
substituted.
